exact_product_requirement: OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures (JNU) exact-product price only for scored records.

reference_freshness.rule: reference_timestamp must be no later than created_at_taipei and no more than 15 minutes old.

outcome_record.target: OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures regular day-session close

scoring.abstain: NEUTRAL_ABSTAIN counts in coverage denominator but not directional hit rate or signed-return mean.
scoring.directional_hit: BULLISH succeeds when outcome return > 0; BEARISH succeeds when outcome return < 0; exact zero is a tie.
